checks.explanation: The predicted 2032-2033 window is 6-7 years out from August 2026 and can't be evaluated yet.

Meaningful, real-world quantum results have already arrived well ahead of the 2030 deadline: Google's Quantum Echoes algorithm demonstrated verifiable quantum advantage in 2025-2026, and IonQ/Ansys reported a practical quantum-advantage medical device simulation outperforming classical HPC.
